name: Kousaka Mayuki
source:
Likes: Sports
Dislikes: Dishonest people

Mayuki is a smart and sportive tomboyish girl, who suffers from mania of saving Kazami School from [url=/c4055]Suginami's[/url] pranks once and forever. While [url=/c4053]Otome[/url] is the brain of Student Council, Mayuki could be called a "right foot", which gives a kick to any troublemakers. She is good at cooking, and quite popular among the students. In addition, Mayuki participates in the competition on behalf of the school athletic club. And it is not just a whim - she wants to follow this path through life. Yet she has a feminine side too.
